objective: Develop a disabled-by-default authoritative World Exchange backend candidate and signed-in RPC adapter; reaffirm item purchases only transfer existing available BP and NEVER credit lifetime BP/Circle Rank/QMP or sell BP as a commodity. Harden exact catalog-linked certificate mappings, immutable provenance and concurrent idempotency without any enabled trading.
productionBaselineEvidence: Read-only GitHub main SHA 536741f8d97fc9dec91503c89f1c1160e5987ce0 and live Supabase schema/triggers inspected 2026-11-21. This is not a verified production APK/OTA fingerprint. No production changes authorized or performed.
chosenApproach: Isolated source-only Postgres changeset with default-OFF gates; server-verified source and escrow/transfer ledger; authenticated RPC client; focused Node and isolated-db SQL contracts, no live migrations or game wallet mutation.
selectionRationale: The current points ledger has active rank/debit triggers. Trading via it would double count or mutate rank. A separate item-and-spendable-BP transfer transaction preserves historical earned BP and rank while allowing cross-cluster exchange.
alternativeApproaches: Reuse public.buklod_points_ledger credit/debit for every trade (rejected: would affect lifetime/rank and other triggers, double count).
Allow clients to submit verified receipts or to mutate inventory and balances directly (rejected: item duplication, IDOR, forged BP).
Turn on real trade against production without isolated authenticated/RLS concurrency tests (rejected: consequential persistence and lack of rollback/verification).
preserveBehaviors: Current application, Arena V1/V2, Character/Kingdom/Cluster progression, ad rendering and navigation unchanged.

No current user inventory, BP balances, QMP, cash, diamonds, production Supabase schema/migrations or OTA changed.

RPC client rejects invalid IDs/amounts/currency and cannot issue goods or optimistic wallet updates.
Escrow/listing/purchase/cancel transactions have server-owned identity, deterministic locks, idempotency and source-revocation gates.
